title: CVE/KEV/EPSS/Dependabot Alert Dashboard -- alerts.json data contract
description: Documents the public JSON data API served at docs/data/alerts.json (also mirrored fields in feed.json). This file changes only when a pipeline cycle intentionally adds/changes a field -- consumers building automation against alerts.json can pin to this schema to detect breaking changes. Not enforced at runtime (the dashboard itself is fail-soft against missing/extra fields by design); this is documentation-as-code plus an optional external validation aid for third-party integrations.

cve_id.description: Canonical CVE identifier; unique across the array.

cvss_vector_components.description: Parsed subset of the CVSS vector string used for the 'exploit chip' UI (attack vector/complexity/privileges/user interaction). Absent for CVEs with no parseable CVSS vector.

epss_score.description: FIRST.org EPSS exploitation-probability score (0-1), refreshed every run for all tracked alerts regardless of NVD lookback window.

epss_score_prev.description: epss_score from the previous refresh, used to render the up/down delta indicator.

kev.description: True if this CVE is present in the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

kev_due_date.description: CISA BOD 22-01 remediation deadline for KEV entries.

risk_score.description: Composite score: 35% normalized CVSS + 40% EPSS probability + flat +25 KEV bonus (capped at 100, weights redistributed if a component is missing).

risk_score_breakdown.description: Explains exactly how risk_score was computed for this alert (component values/weights, whether the score was capped or weights were redistributed).

affected.description: vendor/product strings (NVD CPE-derived or Dependabot ecosystem/package) matched by the watchlist/dependency filters.

vuln_status.description: e.g. 'Rejected' when NVD has withdrawn the CVE -- rendered as a REJECTED badge, not removed from the feed.

first_seen.description: Timestamp this CVE first appeared in the dataset; never updated by later score-refresh cycles.
